questions.stem: Choose the correct word: The new policy will _____ millions of citizens.
questions.explanation: AFFECT (v) = to influence. EFFECT (n) = a result / outcome; (v, rare) = to bring about. Memory hook: A-ction = Affect verb; Result = Effect noun.
questions.subject: Vocabulary

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: Honesty is his guiding _____.
questions.explanation: PRINCIPLE (n) = a rule / fundamental truth. PRINCIPAL (n, adj) = head (of school) / chief. Hook: 'The principal is your pal' (adj = main); 'principle' ends in -le like 'rule'.
questions.subject: Vocabulary

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: She bought pens, paper and envelopes from the _____ shop.
questions.explanation: STATIONARY (adj) = not moving. STATIONERY (n) = writing materials. Hook: envelopes = stationEry (both have E). Very high-hit in SSC CGL spelling.
questions.subject: Vocabulary

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: Her knowledge of physics _____ her engineering skills.
questions.explanation: COMPLEMENT (v/n) = completes, adds to the whole. COMPLIMENT (v/n) = flattering remark. Hook: complEment → complEte.
questions.subject: Vocabulary

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: An _____ danger forced the evacuation of the area.
questions.explanation: IMMINENT = about to happen (danger, storm). EMINENT = famous, distinguished (person). IMMANENT = inherent, dwelling within (philosophy / theology). Three-way trap loved by setters.
questions.subject: Vocabulary

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: Teachers must be _____ while grading; a single biased act can harm a career.
questions.explanation: DISINTERESTED = impartial, unbiased (the grading context needs impartiality). UNINTERESTED = bored, not caring. Hook: dis = apart from personal interest.
questions.subject: Vocabulary

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: The whistleblower refused to _____ the sensitive documents.
questions.explanation: DIVULGE = to reveal secret information. ELICIT = to draw out (a response). ILLICIT (adj) = illegal. ELUDE = to escape. High-hit confusable triangle: elicit / illicit / divulge regularly tested together.
questions.subject: Vocabulary

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: After drought, the farmers had to _____ to the city in search of work.
questions.explanation: MIGRATE = move from one place to another (general). EMIGRATE = leave one's country (E = Exit). IMMIGRATE = enter a country (I = In). Drought-driven rural-to-urban is internal → migrate.
questions.subject: Vocabulary

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: He decided to _____ his right to legal counsel.
questions.explanation: WAIVE = to give up a right. WAVE = hand gesture / water motion. 'Waive his right' is the fixed legal register. Also see: 'a waiver' (n, document that waives).
questions.subject: Vocabulary

questions.stem: Choose the correct word: The minister was _____ for inciting hate speech.
questions.explanation: PROSECUTE = to bring a legal action against (court context). PERSECUTE = to oppress, harass, often on religious/ethnic grounds. High PYQ-hit confusable pair.
questions.subject: Vocabulary
